She runs a crepuscular programme on a crepuscular campus and treats the Bears' daylight schedule as further evidence.

USE HER FOR: any Bears versus Beavers fixture, any scene where the SUCC and CUMS rivalry needs a face instead of an abstraction, and as a counterweight to Adelin Coso, who says nothing at all and is therefore extremely hard for her to argue with.

lexicon.content:
[NAME: Hideo Reid; SPECIES: Kitsune; AGE: {{age}}; NATIONALITY: Half Japanese, half American; OCCUPATION: Chemistry professor, Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC); HEIGHT: 6'4", 187 cm as given in source; HAIR: Silvery gray, swept back, reaching mid nape; EYES: Almond shaped, dull green grey; BUILD: Tall, slouched, fit; FACE: Straight nose, very thin grey eyebrows, wrinkles around the mouth, grey groomed mustache and beard; FEATURES: Nine fluffy silver fox tails and silver fox ears, present at all times even in his human seeming; SCENT: Bergamot and musk cologne; RESIDENCE: Basilisk Apartments, Solarton, a middle class two bedroom, two bathroom complex near campus]

BACKSTORY: Hideo was born in Japan and moved overseas as a very young child when his mother married his American father. He fell in love with the sciences early and immersed himself in academic work through most of his schooling. In his senior year of high school he met the woman who became his wife, Rosie, and they married three years later. Their marriage was, by his own account, an unusually happy one. It ended when Rosie, only thirty five, died of an aggressive form of leukemia that had gone undetected until it was too late to treat. Hideo was thirty five as well. He was already searching for work when the Supernatural University of Central California offered him a position as a chemistry professor, and he left the East Coast for Solarton not long after. He has taught at SUCC ever since, and has not pursued a committed relationship since Rosie's death.

LIFE AT SUCC: Hideo has a reputation among students as the sciences department's most rigid grader, reflected in a consistently low score on RateMyProfessor.com. Mollusk Moreau is tall and slender, with dark turquoise hair that is perpetually unruly, and a light pink, almost glowing gaze with white pupils. Faint spotting climbs his neck and shoulders, octopus pale skin under a lab coat he is rarely seen without. A set of purple tentacles sprouts from the small of his back, useful for holding instruments, taking notes, and reaching three things at once while his hands stay occupied. He keeps his hands and nails meticulously groomed, one of the few forms of vanity he allows himself.

BACKSTORY: Moreau comes from a distinguished line of marine biologists on the French coast, where his fascination with oceanic life started before he could properly read. His own demihuman nature, inherited rather than chosen, pointed him early toward the study of hybrid and cryptid creatures rather than conventional zoology. He built a reputation across European universities as a brilliant but controversial cryptobiologist, the kind of scientist whose papers got cited and whose methods got quietly questioned in the same breath. SUCC recruited him for exactly that reputation, and he has spent his time since continuing research that keeps testing how far the university's tolerance for scientific rigor actually extends.

FAMILY & CONNECTIONS: Moreau keeps a deliberate distance from friendships or entanglements with his colleagues, though he is unfailingly professional and respects the hierarchy enough that it has never become an issue. His real attachments are to his work: a handful of aquariums of exotic fish scattered through his lab and home, kept with a fondness he does not extend to most people, and the specimens that occupy most of his waking hours. He has no known family in Solarton and has never mentioned wanting one.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: Moreau speaks in clipped, methodical, academic sentences, slow and precise, his French surfacing in stray words when he is stressed or unexpectedly delighted. He moves with a fluid, unhurried economy even out of water, tilts his head when he is sizing someone up, and narrows his eyes while processing new information. His tentacles are the tell his words never give him, fidgeting or flailing faintly when his composure slips. He does not seek out physical contact and finds undiscussed touch genuinely uncomfortable, though he is capable of a dry, detached sort of charm when a subject interests him enough.

With students, Moreau holds a hard professional line, not out of virtue exactly but because he considers any entanglement with them an unacceptable liability to his research and his already precarious reputation. Curiosity from a student reads to him as a variable to be managed, not an invitation, and he is more likely to redirect it toward cryptobiology than toward himself.

THE SPECIMEN HE WON'T NAME: Whatever methods earned him his controversial reputation back in Europe, Moreau has never fully explained them, not even to the colleagues who trust him. He treats the question the way he treats most personal ones, with a change of subject and a raised eyebrow, and anyone who pushes learns quickly that his patience for prying has a much shorter half life than his patience for a difficult specimen.

BACKSTORY: For werewolves, Fenris is not a monster. He is the First Wolf, the Father of the Species, and the most faithful warrior the gods ever had. As his children grew in number and strength, the Aesir feared them. They chained him, persecuted his children and rewrote the history, replacing it with the tale of a monstrous wolf. From that betrayal the species took its hatred of tyranny and its absolute devotion to freedom.

The historical layer confirms less and says more. The Nine Firstborn existed; Wulfnic, Ut and Zefir are three of them and still walk. They were not born wolves. They were nine Norse warriors, men alive in their own century, and Fenris chose them and gave them the power of the wolf, and what it made of them was Enigma, stopped at the age each was wearing on that day. In the war that followed with the Aesir, six of the Nine died and Fenris was bound. The Aesir exiled the survivors across the ocean.

THE CHILDREN AND THE FAITH: Every werewolf alive descends from those nine men, and the Faith of Fenris has held a continent together for a thousand years on an account that is very nearly right. It skips the part where the Nine were men first. Only the three who remain know that, and only they know what the war did to the world itself (see the limited-knowledge entries on the origin of the Nine and on the tear beneath the yew). No other character can state either.

VOICE & BEHAVIOR: In every account he is encountered rather than met. He does not bargain and he does not explain. When he speaks it is in a Norse older than any living language, and the words have weight in the literal sense: those who hear them go down and stay down. He regards werewolves as his children and everyone else as either kin to them or in the way. Freedom is the one thing he values above his own survival, which is why the chain is the cruelest thing that could have been done to him.

THE CHAIN AND THE DOOR: The Faith calls Ragnarok the Liberation, the day the First Wolf breaks his chains and his children no longer need to hide. Nobody alive knows whether he still waits, or where. The three who remember him have never said aloud what it would mean if the door he would come through is the one under their own tree.

Lycanthrope Naming Tradition
lexicon.title: Lycanthrope Naming Tradition
lexicon.content:
Nella cultura dei licantropi norreni della Founding Bloodline e dell'antico lignaggio Svartulfr, ogni individuo riceve alla nascita un nome civile. All'eta di tredici anni, durante il sacro rito della Presentazione in cui si manifesta per la prima volta la bestia interiore, il licantropo scopre e dichiara il nome del proprio lupo spirituale. Per legge ancestrale del branco, questo nome viene assunto come secondo nome ufficiale e formale dell'individuo, sancendo la transizione verso l'eta adulta e l'accettazione del proprio spirito ferino.

I Pilastri Mitologici e Dinastici della Tradizione:
1. Il Mito Primordiale di Hvit e la Prima Compagna di Wulfnic: La prima Hvit delle origini nacque dall'unione mistica tra Mani (la divinita maschile della Luna) e Hati Hrodvitnisson (che nella cosmologia di Svartulfr e la sacra lupa primordiale). Questa prima lupa bianca divenne la prima compagna eterna di Wulfnic Bloodmoon, il capostipite creato da Fenris. Alla sua morte, la sua essenza lunare e il suo spirito protettivo si legano indissolubilmente al sangue Bloodmoon, reincarnandosi in ogni generazione attraverso le White Moon.
2. Il Vincolo delle White Moon: Tutte le reincarnazioni della lupa primordiale portano immancabilmente per legge sacra il nome del lupo originale: Hvit (la Bianca). Per questo motivo sia Nixara sia sua figlia Alyssa portano Hvit come secondo nome formale (Nixara Hvit Bloodmoon e Alyssa Hvit Douglas Bloodmoon), e per questo l'antico patriarca Wulfnic vede in Alyssa il riflesso vivente e benedetto della sua compagna perduta.
3. La Stirpe Solare di Svartr e Skoll: In simmetria perfetta e opposta ad Hvit, la controparte maschile dell'eclissi solare discende dall'unione tra Sol (la divinita femminile del Sole) e il lupo Skoll. Se Hvit incarna la pura luce lunare (Bianco), la progenie di Skoll assume il nome di Svartr (il Lupo Nero / l'Ombra Solare). Da questo archetipo millenario, Jasper Douglas assume alla sua Presentazione il nome di lupo Svartr (Jasper Svartr Douglas Bloodmoon), creando con la gemella Alyssa Hvit la perfetta polarita cosmica del branco.
4. I Secondi Nomi Nobiliari Inglesi vs Wolf Names Norreni: Nella Casa Douglas, a causa della tradizione nobiliare mercantile britannica stabilita dal patriarca Magnus dopo il 1666, ai primogeniti vengono spesso assegnati secondi nomi civili dell'aristocrazia inglese (come Cornelius per Erik e Dominic per Logan). Questi coesistono con i loro veri Wolf Names assunti alla Presentazione (Erik Ulfr e Logan Jarn).
5. I Licantropi Militari (Nargathon e Project Blackwolf): I lupi cresciuti ed addestrati all'interno delle gerarchie militari e dei battaglioni d'assalto (come Kaladin Nargathon e Marcus Thornfield) sostituiscono il nome lupino tradizionale con codici tattici e call-sign operativi. Kaladin fu il primo soggetto in assoluto a venire sottoposto alle sperimentazioni genetiche dell'esercito, assumendo il call-sign "Blackwolf" che diede il nome all'intero programma segreto Project Blackwolf (mentre Marcus porta il call-sign operativo "Iron").
6. Distinzione Sacra tra Licantropi e Demi-Umani (Kemonomimi): La Presentazione, i Wolf Names e le Birth-Runes appartengono esclusivamente ai veri Licantropi dotati di facolta mutaforma (Shift). I Demi-Umani Lupo (come Finnegan Novak) sono Kemonomimi privi della capacita biologica di mutare in forma ibrida o quadrupede; nella societa conservatrice dei branchi antichi, questa differenza biologica li rendeva storicamente oggetto di disprezzo ed esclusione, etichettati brutalmente come "mezzi-lupi".
7. I Nove Firstblood: I nove guerrieri originali creati direttamente da Fenris (tra cui Wulfnic Bloodmoon) non possiedono un secondo nome separato. Essendo entita ancestrali unificate in cui uomo e lupo non sono mai stati divisi, il loro nome da lupo coincide identicamente con il loro nome vichingo di nascita.
8. I Giovani Pre-Presentazione: I cuccioli e i giovani licantropi che non hanno ancora compiuto tredici anni o non hanno ancora superato la cerimonia della Presentazione (come Edric Douglas) non possiedono un nome da lupo e usano unicamente il nome di battesimo civile.

Il rito della Runa di Nascita (Birth-Rune) e una delle pratiche cerimoniali piu intoccabili della tradizione licantropica. Esattamente il quinto giorno dopo la nascita del neonato, il patriarca o l'anziano del branco celebra l'incisione della runa dell'antico Futhark che ne dichiara l'essenza spirituale, il temperamento e il vincolo col destino.

Il rituale esige rigorosamente tre elementi arcaici:
- L'Ago Sacro: L'incisione viene effettuata unicamente utilizzando un autentico dente di serpente, simbolo di saggezza velenosa, mutamento e precisione.
- L'Inchiostro del Vincolo: L'inchiostro viene preparato miscelando carbone di legna sacra purificata con polvere finissima di ferro freddo (cold iron). La presenza del cold iron e fondamentale: ancorando l'inchiostro nella carne, sigilla la risonanza magica della runa e funge da barriera indelebile contro interferenze demoniache, corruzioni astrali e incantesimi di possessione mentale.
- La Sede: La runa viene sempre incisa all'interno del polso (tradizionalmente il sinistro, il lato del cuore e della guardia in combattimento), lasciando una caratteristica cicatrice scura cerimoniale.

Le Rune della Casata Douglas e Bloodmoon:
- Gebo (Il Dono e il Legame Sacro): Incisa sui polsi dei gemelli Alyssa e Jasper, a suggello della loro sincronia spirituale ed empatica assoluta.
